Models a language-model route offers

Source: R/llm_native.R
llmmdls.Rd

Asks the provider (or your own server, or a local Ollama server) which models your key can use, so you can pick one for the model argument of llmask or save it with rmoriebricklayer config set PROVIDER.model NAME. The request goes through the package's own libcurl binding; no prompt is sent.

Usage

llmmdls(route = NULL, tmout = 15)

Arguments

route

Character scalar or NULL (the default: the route llmask would take). Otherwise "auto", "own", "ollama" or a provider id from llmprvd.

tmout

Numeric scalar, seconds to wait for the model list; default 15.

Value

A character vector of model ids (possibly empty) with two attributes: "default", the model llmask() uses when model is not given (character, or NULL when none is chosen), and "route", the readable name of the route asked (such as "OpenAI" or "local Ollama"; NULL when no route is set up).

Details

The route is resolved as in llmrte. The list comes from the provider's model endpoint: GET /models in the OpenAI format (own endpoint and most providers), GET /v1/models for Anthropic, GET /v1beta/models for Gemini (only models that support generateContent are kept), and GET /api/tags for Ollama. Perplexity publishes no model list, so its route returns an empty vector. A failed request, a non-200 answer or a reply that is not JSON also gives an empty vector, not an error, so check llmstat when the list is unexpectedly empty. Names are cleaned of control characters before they are returned.

Errors only while resolving the route: "hosted", an unknown route, a provider named with no key set, or a tmout that is not a single positive number.

Examples

old <- Sys.getenv(c("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "OLLAMA_HOST"), unset = NA)
Sys.setenv(XDG_CONFIG_HOME = tempfile(), OLLAMA_HOST = "off")

# no route set up: an empty vector, nothing contacted
m <- llmmdls(route = "ollama")
length(m)
#> [1] 0
attributes(m)
#> NULL

# a provider named without its key is an error
try(llmmdls(route = "anthropic"))
#> Error : no key for Anthropic: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or `rmoriebricklayer config set anthropic.key` (it asks for the key)

for (v in names(old)) {
  if (is.na(old[[v]])) Sys.unsetenv(v) else do.call(Sys.setenv, as.list(old[v]))
}
if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# with a key set, the provider is asked (network)
m <- llmmdls(route = "openai", tmout = 10)
head(m)
attr(m, "default")
}
